summary: Every line typed at the console under load arrives; the scenario is machine/conload_scenario.c and the probe tests/conloadprobe.c

cases.behavior: conloadprobe runs five spinners and a writer on a FAT32 volume and reads 360 numbered lines with their Adler-32 sums, typed in four stages: 200 into a waiting reader, 60 while nothing reads, 200 while a foreground child has the terminal with an interrupt character behind them and 60 more after the child is killed, and 40 before the probe executes itself; every line arrives in order with its sum

inputs.lines: 200, 60, 200 with an interrupt character and 60 more, and 40, each of 37 bytes

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes the disk copy, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot the test image with the copy of the disk to the debug shell
run conloadprobe at the debug shell, type each stage's lines once the probe announces the stage, wait for the record that hands the shell back and end the machine with QMP's quit

assertions.checks: the probe reads the 200 lines typed into its waiting reader in order with their sums, some of their bytes moved by the port's interrupt
the probe reads the 60 lines typed while nothing read
the interrupt character typed behind 200 lines kills the foreground child, and the parent reads the 60 lines typed after it
the probe's new image reads the 40 lines typed before its exec
the probe says that it read all 360 lines
the probe prints how many files its writer completed once for each of the three stages under load
the kernel's record that hands the shell back says that the probe exited with status 0

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case types lines at the console of the machine under load, which a native run cannot
